verdict.rationale: Vector quantization and compression is a fair axis for a vector database like Weaviate, but the evidence pack contains nothing about it. No item covers PQ, BQ, SQ, memory reduction or an accuracy trade-off. The pack covers only hybrid search, multi-tenancy, replication, backups, vectorization and MCP, so the verdict is none rather than na.

support.subject: As an ml-engineer, I can enable vector quantization or compression to cut memory and storage cost with a documented accuracy trade-off
